map.模型 flops 估算是做什么的？: What does Model FLOPs Estimator do?
map.如何使用模型 flops 估算？: How do I use Model FLOPs Estimator?
map.模型 flops 估算适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Model FLOPs Estimator best for?
map.估算全连接层和卷积层的前向 FLOPs。: Estimate forward FLOPs of fully-connected and convolutional layers.
map.卷积 FLOPs ≈ 2·H·W·C_in·C_out·K²；全连接 FLOPs: Conv FLOPs ~ 2·H·W·C_in·C_out·K²; FC FLOPs ~ 2·in·out; MACs ~ FLOPs / 2
map.按输出特征图每个元素所需的乘加次数累计：卷积为 K²·C_in 次乘加、输出 H: Accumulate the multiply-adds needed per output feature-map element: convolution is K²·C_in MACs times HWC_out output elements, times 2 for FLOPs. 1 MAC = 1 multiply-add = 2 FLOPs; hardware ratings often use MACs, so mind the unit conversion when comparing.
map.卷积 FLOPs ≈ 2 × H × W × C_in × C_out × K²: Conv FLOPs ~ 2 x H x W x C_in x C_out x K²
map.全连接 FLOPs ≈ 2 × in × out: FC FLOPs ~ 2 x in x out
map.全连接层 FLOPs≈2·in·out·batch·seq(乘加各算一次)。: FC layer FLOPs ~ 2·in·out·batch·seq (multiply and add each counted once).
map.FLOPs 衡量算力需求(时间)，结合参数量评估推理成本与硬件选型。: FLOPs measure compute demand (time); combined with parameter count they assess inference cost and hardware selection.
map.3×3 卷积, C_in=64,C_out=128, 特征图 56×56：FLO: 3x3 conv, C_in=64, C_out=128, feature map 56x56: FLOPs ~ 2x9x64x128x56x56 ~ 4.66x10⁹ per sample. This shows conv compute grows extremely fast with large feature maps and many channels.
map.FLOPs 越大模型越慢？: Does higher FLOPs mean a slower model?
map.通常如此，但还受显存带宽与并行度影响；某些高 FLOPs 算子若访存密集会被带宽: Usually yes, but it also depends on memory bandwidth and parallelism; some high-FLOPs operators are memory-bound and stall on bandwidth, so real latency needs hardware measurement.
map.约为前向的 2~3 倍(反向含梯度计算)，再乘训练 token 数；大模型的训练: Roughly 2-3x the forward (backward includes gradient computation), then multiplied by training token count; large-model training compute is often estimated directly from parameters and data via Kaplan scaling laws.
